Name: Mutants
Draw: Mutants are human bodies that have gone wrong and kept going. Bulk in the wrong places - one arm three times the other, joints too many, features doubled, skin stretched or split or grown over - and it reads as recent damage rather than an ancient form. What they wear is human clothing that no longer fits: torn coveralls, industrial harnesses, scrap plate strapped or bolted on, tubing running into the flesh. Ugly, asymmetrical, and clearly the result of something done to a person.

ElementDraw.fire: Burned and still burning. Skin blistered black across the growths, flame guttering out of open seams, the coveralls scorched away wherever it comes through.
ElementDraw.ice: Frostbitten. The extremities gone blue-black and hard, ice crusting the seams and the tubing, vapour pouring off the whole body.
ElementDraw.lightning: Twitching. Arcs run between the scrap plate and the grafts, hair and loose tubing lift, and the eyes are lit yellow from behind.
ElementDraw.earth: The growths have gone mineral. Green rock pushes out through the skin and the coveralls in slabs, and the whole figure is crusted and dragging under it.
ElementDraw.arcane: Violet light under the skin showing the shape of what is in there, the extra limbs faintly transparent at the edges, the outline smeared.

Records.Name: Warped Mutant
Records.Draw: Lopsided in shredded coveralls, one arm swollen and clawed to twice the length of the other, the spine pulled hard over to one side.

Records.Name: Torch Mutant
Records.Draw: Both forearms have split open into vents. Arms crossed and held out from the body, head wrapped in rags with only the eyes showing.

Records.Name: Fist Mutant
Records.Draw: No weapon and no neck. A wall of a man in a strapped harness with both fists the size of his own head, chin down and guard up.

Records.Name: Gun Mutant
Records.Draw: A scrap firearm grown into the arm at the elbow, the other hand steadying the barrel, belted ammunition across the chest.

Records.Name: Mega Mutant
Records.Draw: The warped one at twice the size. Bulk piled over the shoulders, the head sunk down between them, both arms hanging long and past the frame.

Records.Name: Grafted Mutant
Records.Draw: Stitched together out of parts that do not match - four arms at four different sizes, staples and clamps holding the seams shut, one hand gripping another of its own wrists.

Records.Name: The Mega Brute
Records.Draw: An enormous slab of a thing whose head barely clears its shoulders, industrial plate bolted directly through the flesh, both arms hanging to the edges of the frame.
Records.Title: Nine Times Made

Records.Name: The Amalgam
Records.Draw: Several people's worth of arms. A mound of reaching hands with one small intact face somewhere near the top of it.
Records.Title: of Many Hands

Records.Name: Prototype Omega
Records.Draw: The finished version: symmetrical, armoured, almost elegant, with a numbered plate riveted to the chest and a smooth blank faceplate carrying one open eye.
Records.Title: the Last Draft
